error.not_a_folder: That isn't a folder I can open.

error.os_auth_failed: Your computer didn't confirm it was you, so I didn't add it.
error.too_many: You already have the maximum number of folders. Remove one to add another.
error.other: I couldn't add it. Please try again.
error.sensitive: That folder holds keys or passwords (like .ssh or your keychains), or contains one that does. Choose a project folder.
error.startup: Files saved in that folder can run by themselves (when the computer starts or as a command), or it contains such a folder. Choose a project folder.
error.ai_config: That's an AI tool's own settings (like ~/.claude or ~/.cursor), or contains them: whatever is saved there can change what your AIs do. Choose a project folder.
